title: Events, Errors, Modifiers, and Validation
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Events, Errors, Modifiers, and Validation and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 8: Events, Errors, Modifiers, and Validation; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 8 roadmap: Introduction to Solidity Events; Declaring and Emitting Events; Indexed Event Parameters; Reading Event Logs; The require Statement; The assert Statement; The revert Statement; Custom Errors; Error Propagation and Reverted Transactions; Writing Reusable Access-Control Modifiers; Input Validation and Preconditions; Designing Clear Error Messages and Failure Paths; When to Use Events, Errors, and State Variables. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
